name: Broke Out Inc.
summary: Established in 2014 and based in Frankfurt Am Main, Germany, Broke Out Inc. operates as a software enterprise with a dual focus. Its core business involves developing and distributing mobile applications and games for Android and iOS devices, which are marketed via the Google Play Store and Apple's App Store. The company further extends its services to include advertising. Complementing its digital endeavors, Broke Out Inc. also engages in the design, production, and sale of streetwear and gym fitness apparel.
